projectDescription: Bolt is a terminal-first AI coding agent that runs in your terminal as a TUI, supporting ten specialized agents, sessions, MCP servers, plugins, GitHub integration, and a desktop app—powered by any LLM provider.
keyFeatures: Terminal-first TUI built with Effect, OpenTUI, and SolidJS
Ten specialized built-in agents (code, plan, ask, code-review, debug, refactor, docs, security, migrate, perf)
Persistent sessions with detach, attach, fork, share, import, and export
MCP (Model Context Protocol) server management with OAuth support
Remote session attach over HTTP with basic auth and mDNS discovery
GitHub Actions integration and PR checkout
AI-powered git commit message generation and code review
Desktop app with multi-window, tabs, file tree, and auto-updates
Headless API server with built-in web UI
Local SQLite-backed session storage queryable with `bolt db`
Support for dozens of LLM providers via AI SDK
publicApiSurface: bolt mcp add / list / auth / logout / debug
bolt debug info / config / lsp / snapshot ...
